metadata.description: skalary plugins for GitHub Copilot CLI. Add with `copilot plugin marketplace add jIRI-san/skalary`, then `copilot plugin install <name>@skalary`.

plugins.description: Architecture notes toolkit — skill-first authoring of interface-level architectural contracts and ADRs, with a parallel docs/architecture-notes tier. /can and /uan are thin prompt wrappers over the skill.
plugins.name: architecture-notes

plugins.description: Self-contained autopilot plugin payload for agent, skill, scripts, schemas, and devcontainer.
plugins.name: autopilot

plugins.description: Code review orchestrator with model-agnostic concern reviewers and a single review-scope emitter.
plugins.name: code-review

plugins.description: Code implementation workflow skill with autonomous execution guidance.
plugins.name: continue-implementation

plugins.description: Implementation plan generation skill for coding workflows.
plugins.name: create-implementation-plan

plugins.description: Design notes toolkit — the design-notes skill bootstraps the docs/design-notes scaffold from bundled templates and creates/updates notes; /design-notes, /cdn, and /udn are thin prompt shortcuts over it.
plugins.name: design-notes

plugins.description: Design review orchestrator with model-agnostic concern reviewers.
plugins.name: design-review

plugins.description: Install, uninstall, list, and update skalary plugins through user-invocable skills that wrap the skalary PowerShell scripts.
plugins.name: plugin-manager

plugins.description: Process PR comments skill for classifying, fixing, and replying to review feedback.
plugins.name: process-pr-comments

plugins.description: Self-improvement loop — /pfb compares delivered work against the plan's captured intent and records the operator's verdict; /si harvests the review ledger, plan learnings, and recorded feedback into ranked improvements to the customizations themselves.
plugins.name: self-improvement

plugins.description: Synchronize local implementation epics and plans to a deterministic GitHub issue hierarchy with dry-run review, explicit apply confirmation, stable mappings, and conflict refusal.
plugins.name: work-hierarchy-sync
